purpose: pilot physical-dose matched donor fiber causal recovery on S4 stalled Sudoku, then EvalMath variation/power gate before confirmation
evidence_scope: exploratory development only; historical checkpoint/dose chosen using previously published native receipts; no confirmation claims on this pilot
test_seal: ARG-03-N 168-case held-out test: never read without separate authorization

sampling.source: new independently MRV generated, solver unique Sudoku, collision screened against available published LOOPSCOPE02 puzzles and SHA IDs from LOOPSCOPE04 representative roster
sampling.public_prior_automorphism_limitation: Historical LOOPSCOPE04 has IDs without raw puzzles; enforce hash disjointness there; full isomorphism only for accessible puzzle sources.

intervention.mode: same-board correlated donor at patch step
intervention.geometry: donor z_H head-orthogonal sphere transplant; sham random head-orthogonal tangent rotated to exact donor-vs-recipient per-cell geodesic angle; sham z_L Euclidean displacement norm matched per cell to donor z_L delta; keep prefix unchanged

analysis.independent_unit: source Sudoku puzzle root (both checkpoints on same root)
analysis.primary_contrast: donor_joint.correct_cells - clean.correct_cells per board /81, primary yagizdevre; compare random sham separately
secondary_contrasts: donor_joint vs random_joint_dose_matched on corrected-cell proportion
donor vs random first-successor cosine to independent donor continuation
gaoxin492 independent checkpoint under same roots
exact_solve donor versus clean and random (descriptive)
analysis.sham_floor_source: one max absolute sham-vs-clean correct-cell effect per root; 95th percentile 95% upper tolerance requires >=59 independent roots

stop_rules: fail if any intervention pre-readout full-head mismatch > 0.001 or state dose mismatch > 0.002 on unclipped nonzero cells
fail if pilot lacks actual S4 roots
with 24 pilot roots sham 95th/95% tolerance is uncalibrated: no confirmation
redesign if target effect <= observed/conservative sham floor or if sham mean corruption exceeds 0.05
never label scalar logit response as task correction
reporting: archive per-root all arms, correct_cells, clean/corrected/corrupted counts, actual zH and zL dose errors, checkpoint SHA, code/roster SHA, source-hashed status; report true corrections separately from random harm
compute: native checkpoints must exist locally; no automatic weight download; CPU source-only and Sudoku generator work without checkpoints
